entities.name: Lazotep
entities.description: A magical blue mineral found only on Amonkhet that interacts powerfully with necromancy; the main reason Bolas turned to Amonkhet.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The world where lazotep is found.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who built an eternal undead army using lazotep.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's undead army coated in lazotep, moved to Ravnica.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Device by which Bolas moved the Dreadhorde to Ravnica; it could only transport non-living matter.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane to which the Dreadhorde was transferred.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: Region of Amonkhet where lazotep was mined.

entities.name: Necropolis
entities.description: Where lazotep was used to create Bolas's army.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Leader of the New Phyrexians, whose control lazotep weakens.

entities.name: New Phyrexians
entities.description: Followers of Elesh Norn whose compleation lazotep can inhibit.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: Phyrexian transformation that lazotep can inhibit or override.

events.summary: Lazotep is smuggled out in funerary barges and used in the Necropolis to create Bolas's eternal army.
events.quote: it was used in the Necropolis to create Nicol Bolas ' eternal army

events.summary: Bolas transfers the Dreadhorde to Ravnica by the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: He then transferred this Dreadhorde to Ravnica by way of the Planar Bridge

relations.quote: Lazotep is a magical blue mineral exclusively found on the world of Amonkhet
